title: GLM-5.3
summary: Full GLM-5.3 on three DGX Sparks at TP=3 with gr8 v1.1.1: high-precision exlr8 bit273 experts (2.73 bpw, v0.6), int4 KV with a 393,216-token pool (393,210 max context), zero-copy shared prefix pages, MTP=3 drafting with confidence stopping, distributed PF_OWN=2 prefill, seven bit-exact kernel paths plus MoE union cap (48 quality default, 32 fast preset), up to 8 concurrent chats, and ~82 s boots from disk. Live-proven 12/12 clean from 119K to 359K single-session and 4x87K concurrent.

configs.label: TP=3
configs.max_tokens_per_chat_note: prompt + max_tokens (unshared) · live-proven: 359K single & 4x87K shared prefix (12/12 clean)
configs.notes: bit273 experts (2.73 bpw, v0.6 @ 3e388b45), int4 KV (CAP=393,216, 2,389 physical pages/rank, max_model_len=393,210, SHARE_LIMIT=32,768, SESS=8, GR8_KV_SHARE_PAGES=1), MTP=3 with confidence stopping, PF_OWN=2 + PF_ATTN_ROWS=1536, 7 bit-exact v1.1.1 kernels ON, DEC_BK_MAX=2048, MOE_UNION_CAP=48 quality default (set MOE_UNION_CAP=32 for fast mode: 85.7 tok/s at C=4, 119.1 tok/s at C=8; or 0 for uncapped exact: 68.7 at C=4, 81.9 at C=8). bench/bench.py default level on 2026-11-21, one fresh boot on a 200G switch, GPU clocks uncapped in timed stages. Lowest MemAvailable: 4.38 GiB after boot, 3.80 GiB after bench, 3.73 GiB after GSM8K/HumanEval, 3.64 GiB after 359K & 4x87K live stress proofs.
